title: Render a receipt in one file laid out top-down
task: In package `receipt`, write `Render(r Receipt) string` for a shop receipt: a header line with the shop name, one line per item as `name  qty x unit = line total`, then subtotal, tax at the receipt's tax rate in basis points, and total, with every amount in cents rendered as dollars. Keep it in one production file laid out so I can read the overall shape at the top and the details further down. Test a two-item receipt against the exact expected text.
